AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
REGULAR SESSION
CITY COUNCIL ROOM
224 S. JEFFERSON STREET
PERRY, FLORIDA
DATE: September 22, 2026
TIME: 5:00 p.m.
1. Call to order. Reminder to silence phones. Opening Prayer and Pledge of Allegiance
to the Flag.
2. Roll Call.
3. Approval of items on consent agenda:
A. Approval to Read by Title Only – Ordinance 1062, Ordinance 1063, Ordinance 1064,
Ordinance 1065,
4. RECEIVING REQUESTS FROM THE GENERAL PUBLIC:
The Council welcomes you to this meeting. This time is set aside for our citizens and the
general public to address the Council on any matter not included on the agenda. This is not
a question or answer time, it is not a political forum, nor is it a time for personal accusations
or derogatory remarks to or about Council or City personnel. If you would like to address
the Council, please come to the podium when you are called, speak into the microphone,
and state your name and address for the record. Please also limit your comments to not
more than five (5) minutes for individuals and ten (10) minutes for groups or delegations.
5. BIDS & RFQs:
Any bids or RFQs that are to be opened in the Council Meeting, and public forum will be
done during this time.
There are no Bids to open at this meeting.
6. GENERAL BUSINESS:
AGENDA ITEM 6(A)- Katie Hall to discuss Anderson Columbia, and Council to take any
actions deemed necessary.
AGENDA ITEM 6(B)- LaDonna LaValle to address council regarding safety concerns in
downtown area, parks, splash pad and other public areas and council to take any actions
deemed necessary.

AGENDA ITEM 6(C) – Public Hearing and Final Read Ordinance No. 1065
AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF PERRY, FLORIDA PERTAINING TO THE AMENDMENT OF UTILITY
RATES, APPENDIX A, SCHEDULE OF FEES AND CHARGES; GARBAGE AND TRASH MONTHLY
CHARGES; SEWER RATES AND CHARGES; WATER RATES AND OTHER CHARGES; GAS SUPPLIED BY
CITY; PROVIDING FOR THE SEVERABILITY OF THE PARTS HEREOF IF DECLARED INVALID;
REPEALING ORDINANCES IN CONFLICT; AND PROVIDING AN EFFECTIVE DATE.
AGENDA ITEM 6(D) Resolution 2026- 29 – Council to conduct Public Hearing on the City
of Perry Final Millage for Fiscal Year 2026-2027 and to take any actions deemed necessary.
A RESOLUTION ADOPTING THE FINAL MILLAGE RATE FOR THE CITY OF PERRY,
FLORIDA, COVERING ITS FISCAL YEAR OPERATION BEGINNING OCTOBER 1, 2026, AND
ENDING SEPTEMBER 30, 2027.
AGENDA ITEM 6(E) – Resolution 2026- 30 – Council to conduct Public Hearing on the City
of Perry Final- Budget for Fiscal Year 2026-2027 and to take any actions deemed necessary
A RESOLUTION ADOPTING THE FINAL BUDGET FOR THE CITY OF PERRY, FLORIDA,
FOR THE PERIOD OF OCTOBER 1, 2026, AND ENDING SEPTEMBER 30, 2027
AGENDA ITEM 6(F) – Resolution 2026-31- City Council, in their capacity as the City of
Perry Community Redevelopment Agency (CRA), to conduct Public Hearing on the City of
Perry C.R.A. Budget for fiscal year 2026-2027, and to take any actions deemed necessary.
(Council must recess & open as CRA Board to discuss and vote, then adjourn as the CRA
and reconvene as City Council)
A RESOLUTION ADOPTING THE FISCAL BUDGET FOR THE CITY OF
PERRY, FLORIDA COMMUNITY REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY FOR THE PERIOD
OF OCTOBER 1, 2026, THROUGH SEPTEMBER 30, 2027.
AGENDA ITEM 6(G)- Public Hearing and Final Read Ordinance No. 1063
AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF PERRY, FLORIDA, AMENDING THE CITY CODE TO CREATE A CITYWIDE PERMIT
PROCESS FOR THE SERVICE, SALE, AND CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES WITHIN DESIGNATED, ENCLOSED
AREAS OF THE PUBLIC RIGHT-OF-WAY ADJACENT TO QUALIFYING BUSINESSES; PROVIDING DEFINITIONS;
PROVIDING APPLICATION, REVIEW, AND OPERATIONAL STANDARDS; REQUIRING APPROVAL OF THE LICENSED
PREMISES BY THE FLORIDA DIVISION OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES AND TOBACCO; REQUIRING INSURANCE,
INDEMNIFICATION, AND A REVOCABLE RIGHT-OF-WAY USE AGREEMENT; PROVIDING FOR SUSPENSION,
REVOCATION, ENFORCEMENT, SEVERABILITY, CODIFICATION, CONFLICTS, AND AN EFFECTIVE DATE.
Page 3
AGENDA ITEM 6(H)- Public Hearing and Final Read Ordinance No. 1064
AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PERRY, FLORIDA, AMENDING CHAPTER 40, ARTICLE III,
“PARKS AND RECREATION AREAS,” OF THE CITY OF PERRY CODE OF ORDINANCES; AMENDING SECTION 40-53,
“HOURS OF OPERATION”; AMENDING SECTION 40-54, “PROHIBITED ACTIVITIES,” TO PROHIBIT PUBLIC CAMPING OR
SLEEPING, UNSANITARY USE OF SPLASH PADS AND WATER FACILITIES, OBSTRUCTION AND INTERFERENCE WITH
THE LAWFUL USE OF PARK FACILITIES, AND UNATTENDED OR HAZARDOUS PERSONAL PROPERTY; PROVIDING FOR
LAWFUL DIRECTIONS TO CEASE PROHIBITED CONDUCT OR LEAVE A PARK FACILITY; PROVIDING FOR CODIFICATION,
CONFLICTS, SEVERABILITY, SCRIVENER’S ERRORS, AND AN EFFECTIVE DATE.
